title: 06 ATG QoS / Service
description: Active ICMP RTT/jitter/loss via oaitun_ue1 + measured retainability. GBR/PDB stay absent without authenticated 5QI (TS 28.554 honesty).

options.content: **Measured:** SSH `ping -I oaitun_ue1` → `192.168.70.135` → `atg_latency_ms` / `atg_jitter_ms` (mean |ΔRTT|, RFC 3550-style) / `atg_packet_loss_ratio` with `five_qi="none"` (5QI not from config). **Unavailable:** GBR & PDB panels below.

panels.title: Latency p50/p95/p99 + SLO 150 ms
panels.description: atg:latency_p* = histogram_quantile on rate(atg_latency_ms_bucket) from ICMP probe (TS 28.554 presentation). SLO 150 ms is a lab reference line, not a claimed 5QI PDB.

panels.title: Jitter p95 + packet loss
panels.description: atg:jitter_p95_ms from atg_jitter_ms (successive RTT variation) + atg_packet_loss_ratio from ping summary (measured).

panels.title: Measured DL/UL throughput
panels.description: atg_thp_dl_bps / atg_thp_ul_bps from DU MAC TX/RX byte deltas (measured). Absent until two MAC samples observed.

panels.title: GBR compliance per 5QI
panels.description: NO DATA — Unavailable — GBR/PDB compliance requires authenticated 5QI + traffic class from OAI/SMF; not inferred from ICMP (TS 23.501 / 28.554).. atg_gbr_compliance_ratio — not derived from ICMP.

panels.title: PDB violation ratio
panels.description: NO DATA — Unavailable — GBR/PDB compliance requires authenticated 5QI + traffic class from OAI/SMF; not inferred from ICMP (TS 23.501 / 28.554).. atg_pdb_violation_ratio — requires 5QI PDB config + latency vs PDB.

panels.title: DRB setup success %
panels.description: NO DATA — Unavailable — GBR/PDB compliance requires authenticated 5QI + traffic class from OAI/SMF; not inferred from ICMP (TS 23.501 / 28.554).. atg_drb_setup_success_ratio*100 — needs DRB procedure feed.

panels.title: Session availability %
panels.description: 100*atg_retainability_ratio{five_qi="none"} — ICMP recv/sent over last probe (measured reachability; not TS 28.552 retainability claim).

panels.title: SLO burn rate
panels.description: NO DATA — Unavailable — GBR/PDB compliance requires authenticated 5QI + traffic class from OAI/SMF; not inferred from ICMP (TS 23.501 / 28.554).. atg_slo_burn_rate — needs explicit SLO error budget config.

panels.title: Probe / loss snapshot
panels.description: atg_packet_loss_ratio + retainability by five_qi/source (measured ICMP path).

panels.title: QoS OAI logs
panels.description: Loki WARN|ERROR lines from OAI jobs (parsed log stream).
